map.计算化学配比各组分量、安全余量及反应放热估算，辅助安全配料: Compute each component amount, safety margin and reaction heat estimate to aid safe batching.
map.A 质量 = 总量 × A配比 × (1 + 安全余量)；放热 = 总量 × 反: A mass = total times A ratio times (1 + safety margin); heat release = total times reaction heat
map.基于化学配比安全模型：由 A/B 配比与总量计算各组分质量并预留安全余量；结合反: Based on a chemical-ratio safety model: from A/B ratio and total amount compute each component mass with a safety margin; combined with reaction heat estimate the reaction heat release, for hazardous-chemical batching safety.
map.💡 A量 = 总量 × A%/(A%+B%)；反应放热 = 总量 × 反应热；温: Tip: A amount = total times A percent / (A percent + B percent); reaction heat release = total times reaction heat; temperature rise about heat release / (total times specific heat 2.0 kJ/(kg·K)); safety total = total times (1 + safety margin percent)
map.反应热为估算值，实际放热取决于具体化学品和反应类型: Reaction heat is an estimate; actual release depends on the specific chemical and reaction type
map.温升估算采用平均比热容 2.0 kJ/(kg·K)，实际需根据物料确定: Temperature-rise estimate uses an average specific heat of 2.0 kJ/(kg·K); actual value depends on the material
map.实际操作须参考化学品安全技术说明书（MSDS）并做好散热措施: In practice refer to the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) and take heat-dissipation measures
map.📚 深度解析：化学配比安全计算（用量/余量/放热）: In-depth: Chemical Ratio Safety (amount / margin / heat release)
map.配料计算：按 A/B 配比与总量算各组分用量: Batching calculation: compute each component amount from A/B ratio and total
map.安全备料：按安全余量算备料量与总投料量: Safety stocking: compute stock amount and total feed by safety margin
map.放热评估：估算反应放热与绝热温升，判断冷却需求: Heat-release assessment: estimate reaction heat release and adiabatic temperature rise, judge cooling need
map.算法：A 用量 = 总量×A 配比/(A 配比+B 配比)，B 用量同理；安全裕: Algorithm: A usage = total times A ratio / (A ratio + B ratio), B usage similarly; safety margin = total times safety margin percent; safety stock = each usage times (1 + safety margin percent); safety total = total + safety margin; reaction heat release = total times reaction heat (kJ/kg); estimated temperature rise = heat release / (total times 2.0) (specific heat 2.0 kJ/(kg·°C)). Temperature rise above 100 °C needs forced cooling, above 50 °C suggests adding cooling, otherwise natural dissipation works.
map.例：A:B=60:40、总量 100kg、安全余量 10%、反应热 80kJ/k: Example: A:B = 60:40, total 100 kg, safety margin 10 percent, reaction heat 80 kJ/kg gives A 60.00 kg (60 percent), B 40.00 kg, safety margin 10.00 kg, safety stock A 66.00 kg, B 44.00 kg, safety total 110.00 kg, reaction heat release 8.00 MJ, estimated temperature rise 40.0 °C, judged as temperature rise controllable, natural dissipation works. If A:B = 30:70, total 200 kg, margin 15 percent, reaction heat 150 kJ/kg gives A 60.00 kg, B 140.00 kg, heat release 30.00 MJ, temperature rise 75.0 °C, watch heat dissipation, suggest adding cooling; reaction heat raised to 300 kJ/kg gives temperature rise 150.0 °C, warning temperature rise too high, forced cooling needed.
map.比热 2.0 kJ/(kg·℃) 是怎么取的？: How is specific heat 2.0 kJ/(kg·°C) chosen?
map.是常见有机液体的近似比热，用于快速估算绝热温升。实际应按体系实测比热与反应釜换热: It is the approximate specific heat of common organic liquids, for quick adiabatic temperature-rise estimate. Actual should use the measured specific heat of the system and the reactor heat-transfer capacity; strongly exothermic reactions must do calorimetry (e.g. RC1) before scale-up.
map.安全余量取多少？: How much safety margin to take?
map.实验室小试常取 5%~10%，生产投料取 10%~20%。涉及剧毒、强腐蚀或价格: Lab small trials often 5 percent to 10 percent, production feeding 10 percent to 20 percent. For highly toxic, strongly corrosive or expensive materials, re-determine by actual loss and weighing precision, and consider unrecoverable wall-loss.
